start.title: La voz de lo alto
start.text:
Una voz llena el cielo.
«Noé, construye un arca. Se acerca un diluvio».

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The voice fades. But the weight in your chest remains.
[TODO:es] Your voice trembles, but the words are true.
[TODO:es] No answer comes. Only the command remains.

mockery.title: Voces de la multitud
mockery.text:
Los aldeanos se reúnen, riendo.
«¿Un barco? ¿Aquí? Estás loco, viejo».

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your words only feed their mockery.
[TODO:es] Their laughter fades behind your steady hands.
[TODO:es] They turn their backs. You are alone in faith.

building.title: Ciprés y brea
building.text:
[TODO:es] Years of sweat. Wood splits. Pitch seals.
Your back aches, but the ark rises.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Rest a while, the work is endless
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Doubt creeps in with the silence.
[TODO:es] Each plank is a prayer. Each beam, a promise.

ark_done.title: [TODO:es] It Stands Finished
ark_done.text:
[TODO:es] The ark towers above you.
Your family gathers, silent before the wood.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Pride poisons the work. You catch yourself.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Thank God for the strength given
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your knees bend. The work was never yours alone.

animals.title: [TODO:es] Two by Two
animals.text:
[TODO:es] Creatures come from every land.
Lions beside lambs. Eagles at your feet.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Fear blinds you. God sent every one.
[TODO:es] They walk past you in peace, as if they always knew.

boarding.title: [TODO:es] The Door Closes
boarding.text:
[TODO:es] Your family is inside. The animals settle.
God Himself shuts the door.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Run back out to warn them again
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The door is sealed. The choice has been made.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Hold your wife's hand and wait
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Together. Whatever comes — together.

storm.title: [TODO:es] The Heavens Open
storm.text:
[TODO:es] Rain crashes like nothing seen before.
The deep bursts. The world drowns.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The sound swallows your cry.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Trust that God is just and merciful
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You bow your head. The ark holds.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Try to pull strangers from the water
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The door is sealed. There is nothing to be done.

inside.title: [TODO:es] Forty Days
inside.text:
[TODO:es] The ark rocks. The animals breathe.
Days blur. Only the creak of wood remains.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Purpose holds the darkness at bay.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Sit alone and let despair grow
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The silence presses on you. Faith dims.

dove.title: [TODO:es] The Dove Returns
dove.text:
[TODO:es] You release a dove. Hours pass.
It comes back — an olive leaf in its beak.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Even now, doubt fights to hold you.
[TODO:es] Tears fall on the small green leaf. Hope is real.

dry_land.title: [TODO:es] Earth Beneath Your Feet
dry_land.text:
[TODO:es] The door opens. Sun spills in.
You step onto warm, living mud.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Rush to claim the new land
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The land was never yours to claim.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Kneel and build an altar to God
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The first stone is for the One who saved you.

covenant.title: [TODO:es] The Rainbow
covenant.text:
[TODO:es] A rainbow arcs across the sky.
"Never again. This is my covenant with you."
